title: Eight Sleep section heading
description: A quiet centered section heading: an optional mono eyebrow in caps, a 32px → 44px regular-weight title with tight leading, a muted 15px → 18px sub-line and an optional underlined link. Each line fades in and rises 18px as it scrolls into view, one after another.
notes: colours follow the surrounding scope: put it in a dark-scoped section for white text
name: eightsleep-heading

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: small mono line above the title, set in caps

props.description: the section title; may hold line breaks

props.name: sub
props.description: one or two sentences under the title

props.name: link
props.description: an underlined text link under the sub-line
